audit.whatIsWrong: The page reads as a favoured lane (tldr 'Bully him early', tone green, diffRating 4/10, report[14] 'Favoured matchup') while diff says HARD and the win rate is 47.37% over 133 games.
audit.why: Four signals, three verdicts. 47.37% is a losing lane, so 'favoured' and 4/10 are not supportable, but diff/diffRating are a judgement call I cannot source from the kits. The mirror (sejuani__heimerdinger) hit the identical conflict from the other side and escalated it rather than picking one.
audit.corrected: diff, diffRating, tone and report[14] left untouched and escalated in questionsForUser. The level chart, which the packet, the whys and the mirror all agree on, was fixed.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spikes and phases are keyed to 'Permafrost's cooldown' as if it were a trackable window, and phases[4] gives no number for Glacial Prison.
audit.why: Permafrost is 1.5s and only fires at maximum Frost stacks — it is not a window you can play around. The real cooldowns that define this lane are Arctic Assault at 18/16.5/15/13.5/12s, Glacial Prison at 120/105/90s, Winter's Wrath at 9/8/7/6/5s, and on your side CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade at a flat 11s and Hextech Micro-Rockets at 11/10/9/8/7s.
audit.corrected: Every 'track Permafrost' instruction re-keyed to the 18s Arctic Assault, and the 120s Glacial Prison written into the level-6 spike.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three separate errors. (a) 'CH-3X center-stun' twice — a fabricated ability name. (b) 'percent-MAX-HP Winter's Wrath' four times. (c) Frost Armor's slow immunity is never mentioned anywhere, and Arctic Assault's stop condition is never mentioned.
audit.why: Heimerdinger's stun is CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade; CH-3X is not in the kit. Riot's Winter's Wrath text is 'swings her mace twice, dealing damage, slowing enemies and applying Frost stacks' — no health-percentage component, and the kit carries no percentHealth flag, so the number cannot be asserted. The two genuinely decisive interactions were absent: Fury of the North grants 'immunity to slows' out of combat, which blanks your turret beam slow and your grenade splash until she has taken damage; and Arctic Assault 'stops after hitting an enemy champion', so turrets do not body-block it — the nest never stops the dash.
audit.corrected: CH-3X replaced with CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade; the invented percentage removed; Frost Armor's slow immunity and Arctic Assault's champion-only stop condition written into the early, late, spikes and don'ts blocks.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns nominates 'Sejuani Permafrost' as the matchup-defining cooldown with no number.
audit.why: The punishable cooldown is Arctic Assault — 18s at rank 1, her only gap-closer, and the one thing that gets her into the nest. Permafrost is a 1.5s trigger, not a window.
audit.corrected: Cooldown block rebuilt around the 18s dash and the 120s Glacial Prison.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells you that a grenade edge-clip is survivable and a centre hit is not.
audit.why: Riot's CH-2 text stuns 'anyone directly hit' and only slows surrounding units — and Frost Armor makes her immune to slows out of combat, so a graze on a fresh Sejuani is close to nothing. The mirror recorded the same distinction from her side.
audit.corrected: Added to dosFull[2] and the trading block.
